description: The bar chart titled “Recall@10” illustrates Recall@10 values for four category labels shown along the horizontal axis, with one unlabeled category at the far left followed by “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking.” The horizontal (category) axis uses discrete labels and appears in the left-to-right order listed, without an indicated sorting rule. There are four vertical bars: the leftmost bar is orange and reaches approximately 0.35; the “- critiquing” bar is blue at about 0.29; the “- scoring” bar is blue at about 0.17; and the “- ranking” bar is blue at about 0.235. No stacked or grouped subcomponents are shown, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the distinct orange color of the first bar and blue color for the remaining bars.
